creator: Alexander Terp
description: Raised 2026-10-07 with the msg --to name fix. join --name now refuses a name a pane goes by, and the daemon draws no word a participant holds, so the clash can only arise from an explicit pane rename to a participant's name on that machine. When it does, the address-time refusal catches it locally, but a cross-machine whom on the answering machine still picks the pane, since Reply::Named cannot say 'both'.
title: Across machines, whom prefers a pane's name over a participant of the same name
